doc: M2-RND-02 underwater look: UnderwaterRig (game/world/water/underwater/underwater_rig.gd). docs/kb/tech/underwater.md. Colours are palette.json swatches (named in `swatches`, tested).

optics._note: transmit is the colour white light keeps after transmit_distance_m of water (sigma = -ln(transmit) / distance, per channel: red goes first). scatter is the in-scatter colour near the surface, fading toward deep with depth below the surface over depth_falloff_m and when looking down. ior gives the Snell window (asin(1/ior) = 48.6 deg). The in-scatter's light level weights the camera's own depth by camera_light_weight (the rest: the path's middle). sun_disc and sun_halo brighten the refracted sun inside the Snell window. The light level is the scene's visible directional lights (energy x colour luminance) over light_reference (a noon sun), at least light_floor: it scales the in-scatter and the underside, so a night dive is dark and the lantern carries it.

god_rays._note: A FogVolume under the surface whose density is constant along the sun's direction, so the volumetric fog draws shafts. Only on tiers with god_rays and volumetric fog on. The fog's albedo is the scatter colour mixed toward white by albedo_white_mix, so Rhen's oil lamp keeps a warm halo instead of turning green.

particulate._note: Marine snow in a box around the camera.

lantern._note: Rhen's oil lamp (decisions_log N-02): the hero light underwater.
